title: R.4 human-truth eval of jury vs pathladder (Ch4 confirmatory)
design: Stratified sample of 250 ERIN reports (train-eligible, unsure, CANCER/NDBE confusions, negation-bearing) graded by a pathologist blind to machine labels. Score pathladder, 8-LLM majority, entropy, and ABMIL trained on each label source against this human set; report kappa, CANCER PPV/NPV, and Holm contrast 4.
decisive_result: If jury-trained AUC on human truth exceeds pathladder-trained with CI excluding 0, Ch4's confirmatory claim stands; if they tie or pathladder wins, the thesis must treat the jury as interchangeable cheap annotation, not superior supervision.

title: PORPOISE on OCCAMS n=87 and TCGA-OAC/pool
design: Finish the cloned PORPOISE loader: build ESCA/STAD omics via their Preprocessing.ipynb + signatures.csv, reuse frozen patient-disjoint splits, run published Cox-fusion vs our late-hist-gen on OCCAMS v3 (n=87) and TCGA-OAC (n=65) plus the n=399 pool. Readout: Harrell C and paired Δ vs histology.
decisive_result: If PORPOISE also fails to beat histology/clinical, the replication-failure claim is architecture-agnostic; if it wins, Ch2's null is method-specific and the reframe must be narrowed.

title: ERIN progression Ch3 arm with prior-grade ablation
design: On progression cohort v3 (1266/181), run pre-registered hist ABMIL, clinical-only, late/early fusion under frozen patient folds; duplicate clinical arm with prior-grade dropped (1.23). Primary metric Harrell C / AUROC with 2000-bootstrap paired Δ vs hist; include shuffled 50-perm nulls.
decisive_result: Fusion Δ CI excluding 0 on progression (not grade) is the only result that could restore a clinical-prediction fusion claim; a null plus leakage ablation showing prior-grade drove clinical AUC locks the 'fusion fails to replicate' story.

title: Unsure-holdout sensitivity + entropy-as-weight
design: Score existing UNI2 ABMIL OOF on the 204 unsure reports (no retraining) vs train-eligible; then retrain with (a) include-unsure as extra class, (b) sample-weight = 1-entropy. Readout: AUC on human/R.4 subset and on jury-eligible, plus calibration on unsure.
decisive_result: A large drop on unsure (or gain from entropy weights) shows reported 0.92 is a selected-easy population and must be caveated; a flat curve lets Ch4 keep the headline.

title: 50-permutation nulls for every off-0.5 shuffle (1.20)
design: Reuse saved OOF pipelines: 50 label shuffles for OCCAMS v2 gen (0.58), v3 shuffle job, TCGA first-pass (0.54), and probes. Report empirical null mean/sd and percentile of the real statistic; no new feature extraction.
decisive_result: If real C/AUC sit inside the 50-perm null, Outcome-D is cleared and small-n nulls become trustworthy; if not, those arms are invalidated and must be dropped from Ch2.

title: OAC-only vs STAD/GEJ visibility learning curve
design: Subsample the n=446 pool by histology (OAC vs STAD/GEJ) at n=65,141,200,300,446; predict TP53/WGD/stage from UNI2 ABMIL with 50-perm nulls. One figure: AUC vs n, faceted by population.
decisive_result: If OAC-only stays ~0.4–0.5 at all n while STAD drives 0.70, genotype-from-H&E is a population effect not a power effect — the exact Ch1 rewrite reviewers demanded.

title: Conditional-ABMIL attention-shift vs permuted genomics
design: On TCGA pool, train gated ABMIL that attends tiles conditioned on TP53/WGD vs plain ABMIL vs permuted-genomics control; export attention mass, top-k tile overlap, and spatial entropy. Late fusion cannot shift attention — this is the only test of whether genomics changes where histology looks.
decisive_result: A real-vs-permuted shift that localises to known driver morphology supports complementarity-beyond-visibility; no shift explains why late fusion never beats unimodal.

title: TCGA-Reports pathladder vs jury vs structured grade (2.19)
design: Run the frozen ERIN ladder prompt and a TCGA-adapted prompt on TCGA-Reports ESCA/STAD (plus 2 extra types already in the corpus) against structured grade/diagnosis. Zero new slides; CPU/LLM only. Readout: accuracy, negation-error rate, organ-transfer drop vs ERIN 0.82.
decisive_result: If ERIN-tuned pathladder collapses off-organ, Ch4's extractor is Barrett-specific (honest methods claim); if it holds, you gain a short methods-paper chapter with DOI-ready numbers at almost no GPU cost.
